basics.name: Shun Zhang
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher
basics.summary: I am currently a junior undergraduate student majoring in Electronics Information Engineering at Anhui University (Expected graduation: June 2027), where I rank in the Top 3% of my cohort with a GPA of 4.31/5.0. My research interests primarily lie at the intersection of Robotics, Embodied AI, Reinforcement Learning, and Computer Vision. I am actively seeking Research Internships / Visiting Student opportunities, as well as Fall 2027 Ph.D./MPhil programs.

projects.name: Embodied AI-Based Full-Domain Delivery System
projects.summary: Innovation Training Program (Under Review). Designed a modular system architecture for quadruped robot logistics (Robot Dog). Developing diffusion-based generative models for mapless indoor navigation. Integrating Reinforcement Learning (RL) to solve path planning challenges in unstructured complex environments.

projects.name: Traffic Sign Detection and Recognition on Huawei Ascend
projects.summary: National Innovation Training Program (Graded Excellent). Optimized and deployed YOLOv5 models on Huawei Ascend 310B edge computing platforms (OrangePi AIpro) via the CANN architecture. Designed a highly efficient inference pipeline and conducted rigorous testing, ensuring robust real-time traffic sign recognition on embedded devices.

projects.name: Collaborative Campus Inspection Platform Based on Deep Learning
projects.summary: National Innovation Training Program. Led the edge computing deployment of lightweight YOLO models for real-time object detection. Engineered autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance algorithms for Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGV).
